Lina: Heads-up: folks trying the new starter on Vercel Edge hit a build-time error: "Can't resolve 'stream'" coming from redwood-js-sdk.
Omar: likely a dependency pulled in Node polyfills. Which bundle path? edge build log shows /dist/runtime/fetch-wrapper.js referencing stream.Transform.
Tess: We traced it to retry logic that imports "stream" for readable-stream backpressure. Node-only code ended up in the default entrypoint.
Lina: Repro: importing in middleware.ts `import { createClient } from 'redwood-js-sdk'` then `await client.generate()` triggers the static analysis include.
Omar: Quick local workaround: import the edge entry directly `import { createClient } from 'redwood-js-sdk/edge'` — that uses the lightweight adapter without node deps. But we should provide a better DX fix.
Tess: Agreed. Plan: 1) change package.json exports so default import resolves to edge ESM for bundlers that prefer ESM, 2) keep node CJS entry under node export for server/runtime. Add explicit ./edge subpath for clarity.
Omar: Example exports snippet: { "./edge": "./dist/edge.mjs", "./": { "node": "./dist/node.cjs", "default": "./dist/edge.mjs" } }
Lina: Also need to avoid top-level requires of node-only modules. Move retry/stream imports into node-only module and use dynamic import guarded by runtime check.
Tess: For runtime detection use: const IS_NODE = typeof process !== 'undefined' && !!process.versions?.node; then if (IS_NODE) { const mod = await import('./node-retry.js'); return mod.getRetryableFetch() }
Omar: Types: TS consumers on Next Edge get type errors because our types reference NodeJS.ReadableStream. Split declarations: dist/types/index.d.ts (shared dom-friendly) and dist/types/node.d.ts (node-only), and point typesVersions accordingly.
Lina: Docs: add short "Edge notes" in README and update starter to import from 'redwood-js-sdk/edge' until we release the stable fix.
BuildBot: CI pipeline: added matrix job that runs `next build` with experimental edge on a small fixture to catch these failures.
Tess: I've opened PR with conditional exports + dynamic node imports + split types. Also added a tiny migration FAQ for starters: "Build error referencing node builtins -> try /edge entry or upgrade to >=0.8.6".
Docs-bot: Drafted docs PR updating README and starter; ready for review.
Lina: Thanks — this should stop accidental bundling of Node-only deps into edge builds. We'll publish a canary once CI is green.
